page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number top left. Main body is one tabular column of chronological text (year-date numbers and regnal numerals in narrow columns to the left and right of it, rules between). Small marginal notes in the left margin. Right margin carries marginal numerals (10, 20, 30, 40, 50).

main_text.p: Narses Romanorum Procerum invidia exagitatus, à quibus apud Iustinum Imp. accusatus fuerat, quum ex Italia revocatus esset, contumeliis Sophiæ Augustæ irritatus, Langbardos, qui tunc cum Hunnis Pannoniam incolebant, quorumque precipue auxilio Gothos Italiæ finibus expulerat, in Italiam evocavit: quam illi Duce Alboino ingressi omnem fere occuparunt; Præsidijsque Græci Imperatoris pulsis, annos ccvi tenuerunt: quo temporis intervallo totam Italiam, præter Urbem, in Ditionem suam sub Regibus xxiii redegerunt.

partim ab Langobardorum PrincipibusAlboinus Andoini F. Primus in Italia Langbardorum Rex. Regnavit iiii Iustinus Iunior Augustus Exarchatum Ravennæ instituit; sicque mortuo Fl. Narsete Italiæ Duce, Fl. Longinus reliquam eius partem, quam Langbardi primo impetu occupare non potuerant, pro Imperatore Constantinopolitano, locata Ravennæ Imperij Sede, sub Exarchi nomine obtinuit. 1 Fl. Longinus Patricius V.C. Primus Italiæ Exarchus annos xv.

partim ab Græci Imperatoris nomine gubernataClephis, Secundus Langbardorum in Italia Rex. Occiso Papiæ circa Kalendas Aprilis, an. MDLXXIII Clephe ab Servo suo, Interregnum fuit in regno Langbardorum annorum x; in quo xxxvi Langbardorum Duces Regnum singillatim per singulas Vrbes administrarunt: inter quos Zabanus Ticinum: Alboinus, Mediolanum; Valarus, Bergomum; Alahus, Brixiam; Cous, Tridentum; Gisulphus, Forum-Iulij; & alij xxx Duces reliquas Vrbes obtinuerunt.
Flavius Antharis, Clephis F: Tertius Langbardorum in Italia Rex.
ii Fl. Zmaragdus Patricius, V.C. Secundus Italiæ Exarchus, missus

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are very small and partly illegible; the first reads approximately "partim ab Langobardis ... Principis" and the second "partim ab ... Græci Imperatoris nomine gubernata". Date and regnal numerals in the columns (MDLXIII, MDLXXI, MDLXXIII, MDXCIII, MDXCIV as printed in old form) are transcribed in the text where clear; the ones in the narrow side columns are not reproduced. Some words in the Latin body are uncertain due to scan quality, notably the lines beginning "Narses" and "Alboinus".
